title: High-Severity Local Alert Cluster
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=local:alert severity_score=* alert_source=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as alerts, max(severity_score) as peak_severity by _time alert_source
| where alerts>=3 OR peak_severity>=8
| sort - peak_severity
description: Detects days with three or more local alerts or a peak severity score of eight or above.
value: Alert clusters often precede weather, fire, or civil events worth adjusting commute and home plans for.
implementation: Ingest local emergency feeds with `severity_score` and review daily clusters each morning.
visualization: Timeline of alert count and peak severity by source.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks days when your neighborhood had an unusual burst of serious local alerts.
